description: This PHP source file defines the 'Menu' controller class within the Opencart admin module. It manages administrative functionalities for menu items including listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting menu structures, with methods for generating views and handling AJAX requests.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Controller class for managing admin menu items, including rendering views, processing form submissions, and handling AJAX operations for CRUD actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads necessary language files, sets page title, prepares breadcrumbs, loads the menu list controller, and renders the main menu management view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Responds with the list of menu items by delegating to getList for AJAX or internal calls.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical list of menus categorized by predefined paths, including nested children, for display purposes.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares data for creating or editing a menu item, including loading existing data, languages, and menu hierarchy, then renders the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates user permissions and input data, then adds or updates a menu in the database, returning a JSON response for AJAX handling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected menu items after permission check and returns the result as JSON.
